title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL com Informatica.
  • Realizar análise de dados para apoiar modelagem e integrações.
  • Criar e otimizar consultas Oracle SQL para performance.
  • Documentar processos e repassar conhecimento para o time.



O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Conhecimento em Informatica e SQL
  • Experiência com SQL em Oracle
  • Experiência em iImplementar workflows ETL no Informatica



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Coordenador Comercial B2C - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Genial Investimentos é uma das maiores plataformas de investimentos do Brasil. Com mais de 2 milhões de clientes, estamos presentes em todo o país por meio de nossos escritórios e assessores parceiros.


Nascemos com um propósito claro: democratizar o acesso ao mercado financeiro , oferecendo produtos, serviços e tecnologia de ponta para todos os perfis de investidor — do iniciante ao profissional.


Oferecemos um portfólio completo que vai de renda fixa, ações, fundos de investimento, previdência e fundos imobiliários , até soluções de serviços bancários digitais , como conta com Pix, cartão de crédito e pagamentos integrados. Também desenvolvemos soluções sob medida para empresas, como Genial As a Service , que oferece infraestrutura bancária via API.


Mais do que uma plataforma, somos parceiros na construção de um futuro financeiro mais próspero, transparente e acessível.


Quer conhecer mais sobre a Genial? Acesse:

#VemSerGenial


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Executar a estratégia comercial B2C por segmento/produto e funil (habilitação → ativação → captação → recorrência);

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência na comercialização de produtos financeiros e assessoria direta com cliente final;

  • Assistência Odontológica (Omint)

  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação (Alelo)

Nosso escritório fica localizado na Praia de Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro.


Etapas do processo

  • Validação Gestor
  • Validação Area Parceira 1

Venha ser Genial você também!

O que é ser Genial?

É buscar a excelência, é fazer acontecer. É ser talentoso, inteligente, curioso e aceitar qualquer desafio. É se apresentar e defender as suas ideias. É colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar e ser apaixonado pelo que faz.


Por que a Genial?

Porque somos digitais, mas também somos humanos. Se você, assim como nós, acredita que investimento não é sinônimo de terno e gravata, queremos conhecer você!


Sobre Nós

A empresa que investe em você! Descomplicamos o mercado financeiro para que nossos clientes consigam tomar boas decisões na hora de investir.


Nossos Valores

Buscar os melhores resultados para os clientes;

Colocar excelência em tudo que fazemos;

Ser uma empresa responsável, transparente e sustentável;

Inovar para inspirar;

Ser apaixonado pelo que faz;

Aprender e melhorar sempre.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles



Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support

title: Account Executive
description:
Near is a startup focused on bridging the gap between remote Latin American talent and companies hiring in the US and abroad. Our team spans 20+ members across four different countries. We've landed numerous great customers and have helped hundreds of people from LatAm improve their lives and wallets with jobs at US companies.


We're looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive who is autonomous, creative, and enterprising to join our team. This is a financially rewarding opportunity with a highly competitive compensation structure – uncapped commission. If you can source and qualify leads effectively, you'll make a lot of money.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve sales targets
  • Expand revenue originated from existing accounts
  • Create new opportunities through outbound prospecting.
  • Close inbound leads
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Leverage our existing network to get referrals
  • Understand industry-specific landscapes and trends.
  • Become an expert in the staffing industry.


Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Native-like English level
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and effectively manage time.
  • A proactive mindset: always pursuing your next goal.
  • Motivated by commission and career growth.
  • Track record of exceeding quota as SDR.


Traits that Would Make You a Strong Fit:

  • Proactive.
  • Optimistic and positive.
  • Intense, driving, and impatient (with regard to results and getting work done).
  • Pay attention to detail when necessary.
  • High EQ – can read the room and connect with people
  • Responds empathetic to others.
  • Follow-through skills.
  • Accountability


Benefits :

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Uncapped commission – the more you close, the higher your commission will be.
  • Results-focused role and team. No BS. No unnecessary processes and bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to grow and work on larger and more complex deals.
  • A team with a great culture.
  • Join a team of high-performers.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Remote Content Writer
description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for a Content Writer to craft high-quality business and strategy questions, case studies, and structured content across diverse management domains with No prior AI experience required . This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical skills, excellent written English, and an MBA/business background who enjoys turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop business/strategy questions in finance, public policy, e-commerce, sports analytics, etc.
  • Create case studies and real-world scenarios for MBA-level learners.
  • Organize content using structured formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • Ensure clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in all outputs.
  • Collaborate with experts to align content with real-world applications.


What We’re Looking For:

  • MBA or bachelor’s from a Tier-1/2 institute in business, economics, commerce, or management.
  • 1–5 years’ experience in content, consulting, research, or analysis.
  • Strong logical/analytical thinking and excellent written English.
  • Familiarity with structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior experience in case study writing or academic/business content.


Why Join Us:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Flexible, remote-first environment.
  • Competitive pay with potential contract extensions.
  • Freelance perks: exposure to advanced AI, flexible hours, global collaboration.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Sourcer Senior

description:

  • Distribuir atividades de forma equilibrada, assegurando que cada pessoa do time atue dentro do seu workload;

  • Monitorar cronogramas, identificar riscos e antecipar ajustes para evitar atrasos;

description:

Organizar, atualizar e manter o backlog com alto nível de qualidade.


Apoiar o PM na priorização e refinamento das atividades.


Garantir que histórias estejam completas, claras e com critérios de aceite bem definidos.


Identificar inconsistências técnicas, riscos e pontos de melhoria antes da execução.


Acompanhar entregas para garantir aderência ao que foi definido.


Documentar regras de negócio, fluxos e decisões de produto.


Manter comunicação clara, organizada e objetiva com o time técnico e de produto.

Capacidade de analisar requisitos e transformá-los em histórias de usuário claras e executáveis.

Noção de funcionamento de APIs, integrações e fluxos backend e frontend.


Experiência prática com backlog, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceite.


Domínio de Jira ou ferramenta similar para organização e acompanhamento das atividades.


Capacidade de quebrar demandas técnicas e funcionais em subtarefas objetivas.


Boa organização e atenção a detalhes.


Vivência com produtos digitais e times de desenvolvimento.


⸻


Competências comportamentais


Perfil analítico e organizado.


Foco em qualidade e clareza.


Boa comunicação com times técnicos.


Proatividade para identificar melhorias e riscos.


Responsabilidade com entregas e escopo.


Postura colaborativa.


Capacidade de ouvir, analisar e direcionar.


⸻


Importante


Buscamos um PO técnico, organizado e detalhista, que entenda o contexto de Node.js, Next.js e APIs, e ajude o time a trabalhar com mais clareza, eficiência e qualidade.


Perfis superficiais ou pouco atentos a detalhes não atendem ao que buscamos.

Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno Mobile Flutter (PJ) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Contínua

  • Evolução do App: Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e componentes com foco em código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Ciclo de Releases Semanais: Garantir a entrega de incrementos de software funcionais e testados ao final de cada ciclo, respeitando os prazos das sprints.


2. Colaboração e Qualidade Técnica

  • Review de Código: Realizar revisões de código (Code Reviews) dos parceiros de equipe, garantindo a manutenção dos padrões técnicos, a disseminação de conhecimento e a qualidade da base de código.
  • Apoio à Liderança: Prestar suporte técnico ao Líder Técnico e ao Gerente de Produto na viabilidade de novas features, ajudando a quebrar requisitos complexos em tarefas técnicas menores e estimáveis.
  • Sintonia com Backend: Colaborar ativamente na definição e consumo dos endpoints, garantindo que a comunicação entre App e API seja performática e segura.


3. Sustentação e Suporte

  • Atendimento de Chamados: Atuar no suporte e resolução de chamados de nível técnico, identificando a causa raiz de bugs reportados e implementando correções definitivas.
  • Homologação e Testes: Testar e validar cada funcionalidade em múltiplos dispositivos, garantindo que a experiência do usuário seja consistente em Android e iOS.


4. Excelência em UI/UX e Performance

  • Garantia de Fidelidade Visual: Assegurar que o produto final seja uma cópia fiel do design proposto (Figma), mantendo a máxima qualidade estética e fluidez de navegação.
  • Otimização de Performance: Monitorar e melhorar constantemente a performance do aplicativo (tempo de resposta, consumo de bateria e memória).


5. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Técnica: Manter-se atualizado com as atualizações do ecossistema Flutter/Dart, aplicando melhorias que tornem o processo de desenvolvimento mais eficiente.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Identificar antecipadamente riscos de integração ou atrasos, propondo soluções ao time para evitar retrabalhos ou bloqueios nas entregas semanais.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Domínio de Flutter & Dart: Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações robustas para Android e iOS a partir de uma base de código única.
  • Fidelidade ao Layout (Pixel Perfect): Capacidade de transformar designs complexos (Figma) em interfaces funcionais com alta precisão, respeitando rigorosamente guias de estilo e componentes.
  • Consumo de APIs REST & Resiliência: Experiência avançada em integração com APIs, com tratamento de erros de rede, estados de loading/empty e estratégias de cache offline.
  • Gerenciamento de Estado Profissional: Domínio de soluções escaláveis como Bloc, Riverpod ou Provider, garantindo a separação clara entre lógica de negócio e UI.
  • Performance e Otimização: Habilidade em identificar e corrigir gargalos de performance (jank), otimização de imagens e gerenciamento eficiente de memória.
  • Testes e Qualidade: Experiência na escrita de testes unitários e de widgets para garantir a estabilidade das funcionalidades core durante as evoluções do app.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco em Valor: Mentalidade voltada para soluções que equilibram rapidez de entrega com robustez técnica, evitando complexidade desnecessária.
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Trabalho em sintonia fina com o desenvolvedor Backend para alinhar contratos de API e evitar retrabalhos nas integrações.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor visual e funcional; o aplicativo deve ser polido e fiel à identidade visual em diferentes tamanhos de tela.
  • Agilidade e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar com releases semanais, mantendo a cadência de entrega e a qualidade sem comprometer a estabilidade das versões anteriores.
  • Atitude de Dono (Proatividade): Identificar precocemente riscos técnicos ou inconsistências no design e propor soluções antes que se tornem bloqueios para a release.


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o \"porquê\" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Data & Security Engineer to build, maintain, and secure analytics infrastructure for a prediction market platform (Forkast). This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, on-chain analytics, and security, with a strong focus on trade activity analysis, dashboarding, and anomaly detection.

You will be responsible for transforming raw on-chain and off-chain data into actionable insights, powering Hex dashboards, Dune Analytics, and internal monitoring systems that support product decisions, risk management, and market integrity.


Responsibilities:


Data & Analytics

  • Design and maintain Hex dashboards for real-time and historical market insights.
  • Build and optimize Dune Analytics queries for on-chain trade activity, liquidity, user behavior, and market performance.
  • Analyze trade activity across prediction markets to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies.
  • Develop data pipelines to ingest, clean, and normalize blockchain and application-level data.
  • Support forecasting and prediction market analytics (volume, liquidity, pricing efficiency, trader behavior).


Security & Risk

  • Monitor markets for suspicious trading behavior, manipulation, wash trading, or oracle exploitation.
  • Build alerts and dashboards for risk and security events.
  • Collaborate with protocol and smart contract teams to assess data-related security risks.
  • Ensure data integrity, access control, and best practices for sensitive analytics infrastructure.


Prediction Market Intelligence

  • Support Forkast market design with data-driven insights.
  • Analyze market resolution accuracy, trader incentives, and pricing signals.
  • Create metrics to evaluate market health and predictive performance.


Requirements:


Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with SQL (especially for Dune Analytics).
  • Hands-on experience building Dashboards in Hex (or similar BI tools).
  • Familiarity with blockchain data (Ethereum or EVM chains preferred).
  • Experience analyzing on-chain trade activity and user behavior.
  • Solid understanding of data security principles and monitoring systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, DeFi, or financial markets.
  • Knowledge of smart contracts, oracles, and on-chain risk vectors.
  • Python or similar language for data processing and automation.
  • Experience with anomaly detection or fraud analysis.
  • Familiarity with Forkast or similar platforms (Polymarket, Kalshi, etc.).


What we are looking for?

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate raw data into clear, decision-ready insights.
  • Security-conscious approach to data and infrastructure.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, crypto-native environments.
  • Proactive problem solver who can work independently.

﻿

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge prediction market technology.
  • High ownership over data and security architecture.
  • Remote-friendly, flexible working environment.
  • Opportunity to shape market integrity and analytics at scale.

  • Início de melhoria nos indicadores globais de vendas

Em 6 meses:

  • Time operando com rotina consolidada e metas claras
  • Pós-venda estruturado e campanhas rodando em sinergia com marketing
  • Primeiras entregas de crescimento de receita e expansão da carteira


Em longo prazo:

  • Criação de squads de vendas com sublideranças
  • Automação de processos com uso de IA e BI
  • Participação ativa no planejamento estratégico comercial

  • Experiência comprovada de 3 a 5 anos na área de inside sales, com pelo menos 2 anos em posições de liderança direta ou coordenação de equipes.

Valorizamos a superação, a meritocracia e o trabalho em equipe. Buscamos pessoas que compartilhem nossa visão de excelência, que saibam liderar pelo exemplo e que estejam dispostas a construir algo relevante e duradouro.


Valores inegociáveis: Ética, honestidade, humildade, comprometimento, disciplina e autorresponsabilidade.

A posição oferece perspectiva de ascensão para Gerência Nacional de Inside Sales, além da possibilidade de participação no planejamento estratégico e expansão da área com novas lideranças subordinadas.

title: AI / ML Engineer (Product-Focused)Cofounder (Equity) – AI/ML Product Engineer
description:
TrueCheckIA is an AI-powered content verification platform built to help companies, creators, and organizations trust the information they publish and consume.


We analyze digital signals, textual patterns, and contextual indicators to generate evidence-based insights that support reliable decision-making across marketing, SEO, education, publishing, and compliance.


TrueCheckIA is a global SaaS product focused on transparency, scalability, and the responsible application of artificial intelligence in production environments.


We are seeking a product-focused AI / Machine Learning Engineer to help build and scale the core intelligence behind TrueCheckIA.


In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize machine learning systems that analyze large volumes of content and extract meaningful verification signals. Your work will directly impact how trust, evidence, and transparency are delivered to users in real-world applications.


Responsibilities

• Design and implement machine learning pipelines for content analysis and signal extraction

• Develop and maintain classification, scoring, and pattern detection systems

• Combine traditional machine learning approaches with large language models when appropriate

• Optimize models and pipelines for cost, latency, and scalability

• Collaborate closely with product and engineering to align technical decisions with user needs

• Contribute to discussions around evidence-based verification and responsible AI usage


Requirements

• Strong foundation in machine learning and applied statistics

• Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals and algorithmic design

• Practical experience applying machine learning models to real products

• Experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)

• Product-oriented mindset and comfort with ambiguity

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field


Nice to Have

• Experience with NLP or LLM-based systems

• Familiarity with production AI systems

• SaaS or startup experience

• Awareness of ethical and responsible AI considerations

title: SR Backend Developer - Kotlin / Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Como Desenvolvedor Back-end Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento e evolução da plataforma do cliente dentro de uma squad multidisciplinar.

O papel envolve não apenas o desenvolvimento de novas features e produtos, mas também a definição de soluções técnicas estratégicas, garantindo que o software seja robusto, escalável, seguro, performático e de alta qualidade. Também será responsável por compartilhar conhecimento e nivelar o expertise técnico dentro da squad, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e evolução contínua.

Responsabilidades:

* Desenvolver e integrar soluções em parceria com fornecedores e times externos, alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos do cliente.

* Projetar e implementar componentes de alta complexidade, garantindo resiliência, performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

* Atuar com autonomia na entrega de soluções em cenários com múltiplas dependências e ambientes distribuídos.

* Promover boas práticas de engenharia, elevando a maturidade técnica do time e fortalecendo a cultura de qualidade.

* Definir e monitorar métricas que aprimorem governança, eficiência operacional e tomada de decisão orientada a dados.

* Liderar incidentes críticos, direcionando a investigação, correção e análise de causa raiz.

* Otimizar custos e performance das aplicações, garantindo sustentabilidade e eficiência do ecossistema.

* Suportar o time em desafios técnicos complexos, fomentando inovação e melhoria contínua.

* Conduzir code reviews, mentorias e compartilhamento de conhecimento para desenvolvimento técnico da equipe.

Requisitos:

* Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software em arquitetura Cloud Native.

* Experiência com Cloud Computing, especialmente AWS.

* Domínio das linguagens Kotlin (principal) e Java.

* Experiência com Microservices, APIs REST e Arquitetura Event-Driven.

* Sólido conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e arquitetura de solução.

* Experiência com Containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Vivência em testes automatizados (unitários, integrados e de carga).

* Proficiência em paradigmas de programação, boas práticas, design patterns e Clean Architecture.

* Experiência com serviços de mensageria e cache.

* Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.

Diferenciais:

* Experiência no setor de IGaming, incluindo jogos e plataformas disruptivas.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Analisar, otimizar e manter stored procedures, views e consultas SQL ligadas a performance, incidentes e integrações.

  • Garantir qualidade técnica com boas práticas, code review, testes unitários e documentação.
  • Criar e evoluir documentações, playbooks de incidentes, runbooks e procedimentos de sustentação.
  • Contribuir para a evolução da arquitetura, identificando falhas, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para N1/N2, orientando e transferindo conhecimento.


Requisitos:
  • Experiência sólida em suporte técnico avançado (N3/SRE), atuando na análise e resolução de incidentes complexos.
  • Domínio de ASP.NET MVC, Web API e .NET Core para manutenção, correções e evolução de serviços.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL Server: otimização de consultas, criação de stored procedures/views, análise de performance (locks, deadlocks, índices, planos de execução).
  • Vivência com frontend moderno: React Native (ajustes/correções) e Vue.js integrado a ASP.NET MVC, além de domínio de JavaScript ES6+ e TypeScript.

  • Experiência em performance no frontend (re-render, memoização, listas), backend (.NET profiling, GC), e banco (indexação, tuning).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de tracing e análise de erros (Sentry, DataDog, New Relic, AppInsights).
  • Vivência com microfrontends, modularização e separação de domínios.
  • Uso de Git, CI/CD e pipelines de implantação.
  • Habilidade para criar documentação técnica, runbooks e playbooks de incidentes.
  • Contribuição para resiliência, redução de incidentes e melhorias contínuas da plataforma.
  • Boa comunicação técnica e colaboração com squads, infraestrutura, produto e níveis N1/N2.

  • Ambiente internacional.
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ

description:

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (BSC/RNC), OSS and Sites
description:

title: Ejecutivo/a de cuentas y operaciones Brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto : Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar: Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:

  • Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas: Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
  • Experiencia Profesional en Turismo: Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2B.
  • Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil : Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.

Competencias sociales y personales:

  • Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad: Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
  • Multitarea y gestión de la presión: Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
  • Competencias interpersonales y comunicación: Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
  • Orientación al cliente: Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.

Lo que ofrecemos:

  • Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia
  • Contrato local con beneficios complementarios
  • Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo
  • Participación en un proyecto innovador y en plena expansión, con un excelente ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de crecimiento
  • Para presentar su candidatura, envíe su CV y una carta de presentación a , especificando en qué medida su experiencia y aptitudes se ajustan a los requisitos de este puesto. Esperamos darle la bienvenida a nuestro equipo y hacer de nuestra colaboración un éxito conjunto.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office;
    CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação

  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio


Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*

  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Sobre a Tidewise

A Tidewise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.

A Tidewise está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro Elétricista com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas elétricos embarcados, domínio de ferramentas CAD para projeto elétrico (especialmente SolidWorks Electrical ) e conhecimento em documentação técnica para fabricação e montagem.


Essa pessoa atuará diretamente com as equipes de engenharia, produção e integração de sistemas, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento detalhado, montagem e validação de sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos em plataformas robóticas marítimas inovadoras.


Trata-se de uma posição prática, com impacto direto nos produtos da empresa, que exige organização, atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de lidar com diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida de um projeto e boa comunicação entre áreas.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver projetos elétricos a partir de conceitos e requisitos de sistema , incluindo a definição da arquitetura elétrica, estratégias de controle e interfaces entre subsistemas.
  • Realizar estudos de balanço de carga , dimensionamento de circuitos, proteções, fontes de energia e consumo elétrico dos sistemas embarcados.
  • Desenvolver esquemáticos elétricos, diagramas de conexão e layout de painéis no SolidWorks Electrical, em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas.
  • Criar modelos e desenhos 3D de montagem elétrica utilizando o SolidWorks Mecânico (3D) , em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas e mecanicos.
  • Realizar projeto e roteamento de placas de circuito impresso (PCBs)
  • Elaborar documentação técnica de montagem e checklists de instalação elétrica.
  • Desenvolver planos e procedimentos de teste para sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Troubleshooting de sistemas, tanto em bancada quanto a bordo.
  • Preparar e organizar bancadas de teste e validação.
  • Atualizar a documentação técnica “as built ” conforme modificações ocorridas durante montagem e testes.
  • Realizar o controle técnico de montagem e supervisar a instalação elétrica.
  • Criação, atualização e manutenção de listas de materiais no sistem ERP (BOMs);
  • Pesquisa de fornecedores e solicitação de orçamentos;


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com software CAD para projetos elétricos (ex: SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical).
  • Experiência com roteamento de PCBs e uso de ferramentas como Altium Designer , Eagle ou KiCAD .
  • Capacidade de desenvolver documentação técnica clara e organizada para montagem e operação.
  • Inglês técnico escrito , com capacidade de leitura e elaboração de documentação técnica.
  • Experiência em ambiente de produção, montagem ou campo, com foco em integração de sistemas elétricos.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, com compromisso com a qualidade da documentação.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência com SolidWorks Electrical e SolidWorks Mecânico 3D .
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de automação, incluindo CLPs e microcontroladores .
  • Familiaridade com normas ABNT , especialmente NBR 5410 (instalações elétricas de baixa tensão).
  • Certificação ou conhecimento prático da NR10 – Segurança em Instalações e Serviços em Eletricidade.
  • Vivência em sistemas embarcados, marítimos ou robóticos.
  • Experiência com ERP e processos de compras técnicas.


O Que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos inovadores e de alto impacto na indústria marítima e robótica.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, dinâmico e em constante evolução tecnológica.

  • Salário e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.
  • Participação em uma empresa que está moldando o futuro da tecnologia naval e robótica marítima.

Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo! ⚡⚓
